analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($181.80) vs SMA5/20/50 ($183.41/$193.38/$179.44) — Below SMA5/20, above SMA50, indicating short-term weakness and mid-term strength transition.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($144.62/$131.76) — Strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (72.9%) + Current price level is in a pullback from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.9 → 46.4) — Attempting to exit oversold territory but below neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -0.9431 → -3.3808) — Turned negative and is worsening, indicating weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $193.38) — Trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($181.00) — Based on pivot and 5-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($196.41) — Based on 20-day high, breakout signals upward trend.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($174.14) matches 20-day low ($174.14), 5-day high ($193.49) is below 20-day high ($217.50), indicating a weak pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.12x) — Normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — Lack of clear direction, maintaining a 'watch' stance.
